audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagree with the mirror, the packet chart and our own whys[]: rows 0 and 2 read Vladimir where the mirror says Skill, row 3 reads Skill where packet and whys[3] say Vladimir, row 4 reads Vladimir where whys[4] and the mirror say Yorick, row 5 reads Skill where whys[5] and the mirror say Vladimir.
audit.why: The mirror (vladimir__yorick) has already been applied; any row we leave contradicting it gets overwritten and, until then, renders a different answer than the prose directly beneath it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 -> Skill; rows 3, 5 -> Vladimir; row 4 -> Yorick. All proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings, as one chart group. whys[0] softened so it no longer claims a Level 1 win on a Skill row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold First item as Yorick's Trinity Force window on a row Vladimir owns.
audit.why: Vladimir's first AP item compounds through Crimson Pact (AP into health and back), which is why the row belongs to him.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names his item spike and redirects you to shoving and plates.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every do/don't body was generic filler under a specific title — 'Swarm into his pool', 'Stack pure HP', 'Anti-heal his sustain' and 'Let him free-scale' all carried the same boilerplate lines.
audit.why: Riot's kit gives the real numbers: Sanguine Pool is 2s untargetable on 28/25/22/19/16s and siphons life from enemies standing in it; Transfusion is 600 range on 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s; Hemoplague is a flat 120s and heals him for each champion hit.
audit.corrected: Four bodies rewritten so each states the mechanic and cooldown its title promises, including that his ult heals per champion hit.

edits.before: Pre-Q Vladimir has no sustain, so Yorick wins the level 1 all-in.
edits.after: Pre-Q he has no sustain, but 600-range poke keeps level 1 even.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Sanguine Pool's cooldown.
edits.after: His first AP item outgrows your Trinity Force — shove and take plates instead of dueling.

edits.before: Dodges your swarm. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 2s untargetable on 28/25/22/19/16s — bait it first.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Transfusion heals him every 9s at rank 1 — Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The pool siphons life from everyone on it — walk your ghouls out of it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Health alone does nothing to his magic damage — buy MR early.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Hemoplague heals him for each champion hit on a flat 120s — punish that window, not his farm.

notes: The mirror's open conflict is still here on our side too: spikes[2].text calls first item Yorick's peak in places while the row is now Vladimir's. I did not rewrite spikes[2] because its own body already argues Vladimir's spike; the conflicting framing lives in phases[5].why, which I corrected.
